findings.claim: The diff changes `addons/intelligence/app/llm.py` (a JSON-mode fallback that latches per client and drops `response_format` after a 400) and adds about 520 lines to `tests/test_llm.py`, but neither file is a touch point of SPEC-ADDON-012/013/014 or 009/010/011, and the SPEC-ADDON-008 that the tests cite has no spec anywhere under docs/.
findings.impact: Every JSON caller of LLMClient (refine, summaries, keywords, Ask, anything that uses generate_json / generate_json_result / generate(response_format=json_object)) now behaves differently against providers that answer 400. Once one 400 is followed by an answer without the field, `_json_mode_rejected` latches for the life of the client. From then on, JSON mode is never sent to that provider again, and the empty-body retry in the JSON path is skipped. This behavior was reviewed against no declared invariant, so a regression in it would not be traced to any approved spec.
findings.evidence: addons/intelligence/app/llm.py:356 (`_JSON_OBJECT_FORMAT`), :468 (latch), :577-582, :608-614 (latching), :650-668 (400 resend without response_format, not charged to retry_attempts), :1242 (empty-body retry suppressed once latched). Grep for `SPEC-ADDON-008` under docs/ returns no files; the only matches are app/llm.py and tests/test_llm.py, where test comments cite 'SPEC-ADDON-008 (I1..I10)', which no document defines. docs/specs/INDEX.md in the diff lists 009-014 but not 008. The touch points of both specs in the diff name neither llm.py nor test_llm.py.
findings.repro: Read the touch-point list of docs/specs/whisper-langdetect-vad-aligner-sentences.md and of docs/specs/whisper-langdetect-refine-digits.md, then the diff: the llm.py hunk and the test_llm.py hunk appear in neither. Running Grep with the pattern `SPEC-ADDON-008` on the docs/ path returns no matches.

bucket_proposal.reason: An unspecified behavior change to the shared LLM client rides on a branch whose specs do not cover it. Its tests cite invariants (I1-I10) of a spec that does not exist, so no approved document is what they are checked against. No declared invariant of 012-014 is broken, so this is not A. The planning gap is that the change has no spec at all.

findings.proposed_fix: Either write and approve the SPEC-ADDON-008 spec (with llm.py and tests/test_llm.py as its touch points) and add it to INDEX.md, or move the llm.py and test_llm.py changes to their own branch. Separately, the comment block at llm.py:349-355 describes `_RESPONSE_FORMAT_SUSPECT_FAILURES` but now sits above `_JSON_OBJECT_FORMAT`; move the constant above the comment.

specification_compliance: The touch-point list for 012-014 covers whisper.py `_detect_language` / `_decode_detection_sample` / constants, aligner.py `align_segment`, subtitle_builder.py `_balance_two_lines` and tests. The diff also reaches llm.py and test_llm.py (no spec at all, F1), whisper.py 011/010 sites (F2), build_cues / _safe_break_between (F3), the refine prompt, the example config and the addon docs (F4), and creates digit_separator.py with new `splits_number` (F5).

Everything except llm.py / test_llm.py is accounted for by the touch points of SPEC-ADDON-009/010/011 in docs/specs/whisper-langdetect-refine-digits.md, which is in the same diff and approved per INDEX.md.
The spec files, INDEX.md and the review records are implicit touch points and are not reported.
potential_unspecified_behavior: LLMClient latches `_json_mode_rejected` after one 400 followed by a successful resend without response_format, and never sends json_object mode on that client again (llm.py:608-614).
Once latched, the empty-body retry in the JSON path is skipped (llm.py:1242).
A 400 to a json_object request is resent once without the field and not counted against retry_attempts (llm.py:650-668).
regression_risks: The llm.py fallback affects every JSON LLM caller (refine, summaries, Ask, keywords) for providers that 400. A transient 400 on a json_object request followed by a success latches the client off JSON mode for its lifetime, which may lower JSON compliance on providers that do support it.
The 010 digit-separator rule in `_build_chunks_from_words` and `build_cues` changes chunk and cue boundaries for every provider, outside the 012-014 invariants.
test_coverage: tests/test_llm.py adds TestJsonModeFallback, labelled with invariants of a SPEC-ADDON-008 that no document defines.
